title: Snub Mosley and the slide saxophone
summary: Mosley, with Alphonso Trent, played a unique slide saxophone and was an exciting salesman.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Snub Moseley was with Alphonso Trent. He played a thing and still does today called a slide saxophone. I think it's the only one in existence. I've never heard of anyone else having it.
He was a very exciting trombone player. He played a lot of exciting things and he was quite a salesman. He has a little band around now, right today. Snub Moseley.
And the slide saxophone, it looked like, almost like
a soprano only it had a slide on it. It had the mouthpiece and the reed and everything.
